dct_title_s: Totius Africae: nova repræsentatio qua præter diversos in ea Status et Regiones, etiam Origo Nili ex veris RR. PP.
dct_alternative_sm: Totius Africae: nova repræsentatio qua præter diversos in ea Status et Regiones, etiam Origo Nili ex veris RR. PP.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; [Prime meridian: Tenerife.]; Title appears in decorative cartouche with people, putti, and animals including snakes, a sheep-like creature, and a tortoise. A pile of elephant tusks lies in the foreground.; Statement of Responsibility: "Missionariorum Relationibus ostenditur á Io Baptista Homann Sac. Cæs. Maj. tis Geographo."; Inscribed to the upper left of the title cartouche: "Benevole Spectator: Ludolphum hactenus incaute secuti sunt; qui novo quodam sistemate originem Nili recentioribus Tabu: lis suis perperam inseruerunt. Nos authoritatem Viri maxime Reve. P. Henrici Schereri S.I. Geographi celeberrimi, qui ex veris PP Missionariorum."; Between inner and outer neatline, top and bottom: "Septentrio" and "Meridies."; Inside neatline at the west and east: "Occidens" and "Oriens."; Description of climates is inscribed between the inner and outer neatlines, at the west and east of the map: "Clima ..."; Shows several islands in the Red Sea ("Mare Rubrum") and in the Mozambique Canal ("Mare Zanguebarie").; Shows both real and fictitious St. Helena Islands--From dealer description.; Shows the source of the Nile (inaccurately) as two side-by-side lakes--From dealer description. Publisher not identified (Norimbergæ)
47 x 56 centimeters on sheet 52 x 60 centimeters
